title: EC 1.2.4 · Random: ROC and PR curves
caption: Test-set ROC (top) and precision–recall (bottom) curves for seven classifiers on conjoint-triad (left) and k-separated bigram PSSM (right) features, EC 1.2.4 random split, n = 94 with 27% positive. The thin horizontal line in the PR panels is the positive prevalence. Highest AUROC among the 14 curves: Conjoint triad with Random forest (0.998).
